name: The Pleasance play area
description: The play area on The Pleasance is Aberlady's village play park. Its centrepiece is a pirate ship with a cargo net, wobble bridge and slide, chosen by pupils at Aberlady Primary School, and there's also a spinner, springers and swings. The council rates it for children up to about 11.
